sections.name: Priya Vishwanathan
sections.sub: She helped build and scale amã Stays & Trails. <t>Thirty-five years with IHCL.</t>

items.k: A homestay brand, built and scaled.
items.t: In her words, the most fulfilling chapter of thirty-five years with IHCL: helping build and scale amã Stays & Trails into a distinctive hospitality brand. As General Manager: the P&L, the owners and the guests, across India.
items.d: From nine bungalows at launch to 370+ today. IHCL figures.

items.t: Joined IHCL in 1990 from IHM Pusa. St. James’ Court in London, the Taj Mahal in New Delhi, then eight years as Regional Manager for Karnataka.
items.d: Front office, club floors, quality and operations.

items.t: Fifteen years in Business Excellence, helping isolated hotels work as one organisation with common standards. Senior Assessor of the Tata Business Excellence Model.
items.d: Customer-satisfaction work across more than 100 hotels.
